prior.base_measure: Lebesgue dx in original entering x chart
prior.normalizer: Z_D common to both arms, omitted only from MAP/cost contrasts

numerical_policy.derivatives: Analytic full objective gradient/Hessian and two SOC constraint Jacobians/Hessians; no finite differences in solves
numerical_policy.coordinate_map: x=common_warm_start + diag(public_unsplit_SD)*u; same origin/scales for both arms; x density base measure unchanged
numerical_policy.objective_offset: Drop each quadratic's constant value at the common warm start from its optimizer objective only; preserve it in every reported cost
numerical_policy.constraint_scale: SOC path slacks divided by public unsplit SOC SD; box constraints in u
numerical_policy.evaluation_accounting: Every actual objective/gradient kernel evaluation, any Hessian-triggered evaluation, and one forced final verification consume the same cap; final slot reserved. Cached Hessians and callback logging do not evaluate an objective. Raw SciPy nfev/njev/nhev also reported.
numerical_policy.stopping_rationale: gtol equals the independently checked numerical KKT tolerance; initial barrier is1/64 of that tolerance because SciPy can report gtol success before its barrier complementarity is small
numerical_policy.KKT_checks: Relative scaled stationarity, absolute scaled complementarity and dual violation <=KKT tolerance; strict raw feasibility and optimizer success additionally required for converged status
numerical_policy.feasibility_arithmetic: Compute SOC using charge/exp(logQ), matching model order. Report gamma(64)*max(1,operand magnitudes) allowances separately; raw negative slacks are never clipped or accepted for model evaluation
numerical_policy.linear_algebra: No eigenvalue clipping, pseudoinverse covariance, covariance repair or curvature inversion; unmodified spectra reported diagnostically. trust-constr QR may fall back to SVD for constrained optimization; all emitted warnings are recorded and this does not define a posterior covariance.
numerical_policy.curvature_interpretation: Local surrogate and prior curvature only; no calibrated intervals, supported moments or posterior probabilities
numerical_policy.thread_policy: Supervisor sets single-thread BLAS environment before importing numpy/scipy; this module never changes process-global thread settings

reporting_prior_derivative_evaluations: Parent may count two separate post-inference derivative evaluations; these change no candidate or optimizer call count
